categories.main_business_segments: Shanghai SBT Ultrasonic Technology Co., Ltd. primarily engages in the research, design, production, and sales of ultrasonic welding, cutting equipment, and related accessories. Its main product applications span new energy batteries, wire harness connectors, semiconductors, rubber tires, and non-woven fabrics. The company also provides automation solutions for new energy power battery manufacturing.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company has developed a comprehensive ultrasonic technology platform including ultrasonic power supply technology, piezoelectric transducer simulation design, acoustic tool design, controller development, intelligent online detection, and automation systems. Key innovations include integrated wedge welding technology, ultrasonic metal welding quality monitoring, high-speed rolling welding systems, dual-phase synchronous ultrasonic power technology, and ultrasonic dust removal technology. Production involves assembly, software programming, aging, testing, and quality control, with some non-core processes outsourced.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers are leading enterprises in new energy batteries (e.g., CATL, BYD), automotive wire harness and connectors (e.g., LEMO, TE Connectivity, Aptiv), semiconductor industry (e.g., SAIC Infineon, CRRC Times), and tire manufacturers (e.g., Goodyear, Hankook). The company serves industries including new energy vehicles, semiconductor packaging and testing, automotive electronics, and tire manufacturing.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with headquarters in Shanghai and subsidiaries in Wuxi, Hong Kong, Singapore, and Germany. Its sales and services cover domestic markets extensively and include some overseas operations, with export sales denominated in USD, EUR, and other currencies.
categories.supply_chain_position: Shanghai SBT Ultrasonic Technology operates mainly in the midstream segment of the supply chain, manufacturing ultrasonic welding and cutting equipment used by downstream manufacturers in battery, semiconductor, automotive wiring, and tire industries. It also supplies related accessories and provides automation solutions.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company emphasizes continuous R&D investment focused on high-end ultrasonic applications, expanding into semiconductor advanced packaging, medical, hydrogen energy, and aerospace sectors. It prioritizes innovation in ultrasonic power systems, intelligent quality monitoring, AI defect detection, and automation integration. Collaborations with top universities and a strong patent portfolio support its technology leadership.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of ultrasonic equipment and accessories, as well as providing related automation solutions and technical services. The company uses a direct sales model supported by a dedicated marketing and technical service team.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company competes with international leaders such as Emerson's Binics, Sonics, Herrmann, Sonoscan, K&S, ASM, and PVA in ultrasonic equipment. It has been gradually increasing its market share domestically by breaking foreign monopolies in high-end ultrasonic welding and scanning equipment, positioning itself as a leading domestic ultrasonic technology platform provider.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 584.55 million, a year-on-year increase of 11.3%, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 85.87 million, up 29.04%. Total assets were RMB 2.13 billion with a slight decrease from the previous year. R&D investment accounted for 21.65% of revenue, reflecting a growth-oriented profile with strong emphasis on innovation.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company offers advanced ultrasonic welding and cutting solutions characterized by high precision, stability, energy efficiency, and real-time quality monitoring. Its integrated ultrasonic technology platform and AI-enabled defect detection provide superior product quality and reliability. The company differentiates itself through localized, responsive customer service and the ability to customize solutions for diverse industrial applications.
